notes.title: "Christmas" Update
notes.content:
Given the continually troubled development of Episode 2, I figured I'd have some fun going back and making another little expansion for Episode 1. A new - Christmas themed - eventchain has been added, along with a new starmap location to trigger it, And I truly hope you all enjoy the new content :3

And a belated happy holidays~

notes.title: Halloween Update
notes.content:
As it is the holidays, and this game has not really had any updates since it was released, I figured I might slap together a quick holiday update as a bit of a treat~

New in the update is an aditional planet you may visit, with it's own contained storyline. 25 more pages of text, and 10 new artworks. I do hope you enjoy, and happy halloween~
